title: dedicated-capacity-weekly-prep-maya-patel-2026-03-06
content:
Weekly prep for dedicated capacity sync - 2026-03-06

Goals for this meeting:
- Align on near-term (next 6 weeks) GPU reservations and runway for Q2 launch waves.
- Validate autoscaling thresholds based on current utilization patterns.
- Decide whether to accept an early reserved commit from AcmeAI (see notes).

Quick snapshot (as of 2026-03-05):
- Total dedicated pool (prod): 256 GPUs (160 A100 80GB + 96 H100 80GB; note: some H100 in canary cluster)
- Current steady-state utilization: ~62% tokenized (avg across routes), peak daily 78% (1-2h window)
- Pending reservation requests (not finalized):
  - AcmeAI: 40 H100 reserved, 12-month term, start 2026-04-01 (sales wants yes but ops flagged cooling/time to provision)
  - NovaML: +16 A100 for 3 months (pooled burst)
- Forecast assumptions for next 8 weeks:
  - Baseline organic growth: +8% w/w for hosted->dedicated migrations (tracked via Onboarding funnel)
  - Sales-provided pipeline: +60 GPUs committed across three customers, phasing over weeks 4-8
  - Conservatively assume 20% headroom target for SLOs

Preliminary numbers (rough):
- Week 0 (now): 256 total, used ~159 (62%), free ~97
- Week 4 (conservative): add 40 reserved -> planned total 296, expected used 190 (64%) -> free ~106
- Week 8 (with pipeline): planned total 356, expected used 260 (73%) -> free ~96

Notes: these are blended A100/H100 counts and don't account for model-specific placement constraints (e.g., some customer models need H100 only). We need per-customer device affinity table before final sign-offs.

Autoscaling/Policy items to review:
- Current scale-out trigger: pool-wide 70% average utilization sustained >5 minutes.
- Current scale-in trigger: <40% for 15 minutes.
- Max pool cap currently set to 320 (hard cap) - we should evaluate raising to 380 if pipeline converts.
- Burst buckets: allow ephemeral +10% burst from spare spot-like instances for latency-sensitive routes.

Operational concerns / risks:
- Provisioning lead time: H100 procurement / rack prep still 3-4 weeks; if we accept AcmeAI start 4/1 we need approval today to hit timeline.
- Placement fragmentation: mixing A100/H100 increases scheduling overhead; propose tagging reservations by device_type to reduce failures.
- Cost delta: H100 reservations increase op-ex by ~28% vs A100 - need sign-off from finance for committed pricing.
- Canary failures: last week saw 2x OOMs on model X on H100 after quantized rollout - tied to kernel selection; SRE tracking (see linked PR).

Discussion points for the sync:
1) AcmeAI reservation: accept as-is / negotiate start date / convert some H100 to A100? (Sales/Legal/Finance input needed)
2) Autoscaler thresholds: raise scale-out trigger to 75% to reduce churn? tradeoff = less headroom for spikes.
3) Max pool cap: increase to 380 vs keep 320. Pros/cons and procurement risk.
4) Reservation tagging: enforce device_type tag on all reservation contracts.
5) Short-term burst plan: enable ephemeral GPU pool (+10%) for 6 weeks during Q2 ramp.

Action items (owners + due):
- AM: get final terms from AcmeAI (Liam Chen) - due EOD 2026-03-06
- Confirm per-customer device affinity table (Hannah Kim) - due 2026-03-08
- Cost impact calc for H100-heavy reservations (Finance sync) (Jordan Lee + Finance) - due 2026-03-09
- Evaluate raising autoscale trigger to 75% in staging for 48h and report latency/regression (SRE: Ryan Wood) - start 2026-03-07, report by 2026-03-10
- PR to enforce reservation tagging in provisioning service (infra repo) (Maya Patel) - draft by 2026-03-09

Notes-to-self / talking points:
- Emphasize runway and procurement lead times to Sales; can't compress H100 lead time without express commit.
- If Sales insists on 4/1, propose a hybrid: accept reservation but defer H100 assignment until week 2, provide A100 interim with performance caveat.
- Watch kernel/quantization fix from infra PR #789 closely - that resolved two OOMs in canary, but needs staging soak.

Open questions / stuff to raise in sync:
- Do we have legal template approval for multi-year H100 pricing? (Jordan to confirm)
- How much buffer do we require for cross-customer spikes (recommend 15-20% rather than current 10%)?
- Is it acceptable to increase max pool cap now, given rack/space constraints in Europe region? need infra confirm.

Appendix - quick calc back-of-envelope (for talking to Sales):
- If AcmeAI takes 40 H100 reserved -> incremental annual cost to Redwood ops (run rate) ~ $1.1M (rough) before revenue offsets.
- If we increase max cap to 380 and add ephemeral +10% burst, expected peak capacity ~ 418 GPUs but ephemeral are on short lease so net committed ~380.

Meeting logistics:
- 30m sync, agenda above; start with Acme decision (10m), autoscale policy (8m), cap + reservations (7m), action review (5m).

End notes: keep this doc informal - will push clean notes to confluence after meeting if decisions made.

Random TODOs to drop later into tickets:
- ticket: infra/provisioning -> enforce reservation device_tag (assign to Maya)
- ticket: sre/soak -> autoscale-staging-75pct experiment (assign to Ryan)
- ticket: finance -> H100 cost analysis (assign to Jordan)
- follow-up: sales -> notify Acme of tentative decision (Liam)
